title: Polish Sausage and Fennel Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish featuring polish sausage and crunchy fennel, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Dish soap
ingredients.notes: do not use, mistake in ingredient name - use olive oil instead

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced fennel and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with umami seasoning, salt, and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fennel if desired.
